name: What is involved in the water softener replacement process?

mainEntity.name: What is involved in the water softener replacement process?

acceptedAnswer.text: The water softener replacement process typically involves draining and disconnecting the old unit, preparing the new unit for installation, and then connecting it to your home's water supply and drainage system. This includes ensuring proper pipe connections, setting up the brine tank, and initiating the system's first regeneration cycle. Our licensed plumbers also test the new system thoroughly to confirm it's operating correctly and provide instructions on its use and maintenance. We handle all aspects, from removal of the old unit to final system check-out, ensuring a seamless transition.
acceptedAnswer.description: The process involves disconnecting the old unit, connecting the new one to water and drainage, setting up the brine tank, and testing for proper operation. Our plumbers handle all steps from removal to final check.
